name: FastLaunch
conditions: Free Launch is $0 but limited to 5 slots per day with up to a 180-day scheduling window — a queue.
Free-tier dofollow backlink is conditional: only if the project ranks Top 3 in its daily ranking.
requirements: Account required — /projects/submit redirects to sign-in (Google or GitHub OAuth shown).
All launches happen at 8:00 AM UTC; a limited number launch each day.
Tech products/projects broadly (AI, SaaS, design tools, e-commerce, etc.).
preparation: Project name, logo, tagline, description, categories.
A launch-date strategy: free slots schedule up to 180 days out.
Vote mobilization plan if you want the free-tier dofollow (Top 3 daily).
Plan choice: Free / Premium $9.9 (guaranteed dofollow, 12 premium slots/day, earlier dates, homepage feature for one year) / Sponsor $149.
workflow: Complete the submission and pick a launch date (free: next available shown on site, e.g. '5 slots').
On launch day (8:00 AM UTC), compete in 'Top Projects Launching Today' — Top 3 earns the free dofollow; Premium's is guaranteed.
watchFor: Free-tier dofollow depends on a Top-3 daily finish — not guaranteed.
Free scheduling can push months out (180-day window, 5 slots/day); Premium's earlier dates are the upsell.
Sponsor is a $149 one-year homepage spot — separate product, not a listing requirement.
Same DirEasy boilerplate family as devtoolsdir.com — shared launch mechanics.
After sponsor payment you must 'contact support@fastlaunch.io' — manual fulfillment.
countsAsLive: The project appears in fastlaunch.io's daily launch listing on its scheduled date with a public detail page; Premium listings also show on the homepage feature slot.
unknowns: Exact free wait time at current queue depth.
Whether votes can be solicited externally without restriction.

sources.title: FastLaunch Pricing — Free (5 slots/day, 180-day window, dofollow iff Top 3), Premium $9.9, Sponsor $149
